A member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], this '''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he constructed a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] by the time the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] declared war. Taking up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], he led [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in at least one battle; he assisted [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] during the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|battle]] of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. Together, the Jedi and clone rescued [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from a Confederate prison established on the world.<ref name="TCWg" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Jedi's only appearance was in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (mobile)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' mobile game]].
During the events shown in the wireless game, the main character, Denal sometimes encounters a Jedi. At one point during the game, this Jedi appears right after the player receives a message from Obi-Wan Kenobi. Also, he knows both Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, and he is important enough for Skywalker to risk and send his Padawan alone to assist him. However, this character is called just "Jedi" in the dialogue windows and wears a hood, making it impossible to identify him with Kenobi.
